fact_text: The interviewee described the FY27 budget as very pro-real-estate and said the property sector welcomed it as a healthy base for growth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said property transaction volumes fell sharply after the 2022-2024 tax measures on real estate and picked up again in 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The FY27 budget abolished the 7E tax, which assumed property owners earned a deemed return of about 5% on their property and taxed that deemed income above a threshold.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said national average returns on non-commercial property asset classes are below the 5% deemed return, so the 7E charge was a significant burden on owners and investors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said the government's direction on property tax reform is right, but IMF conditions limit how fast remaining levies such as the 7K tax can be removed, which industry still wants.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said the FY27 budget's Section 159 1C measure is a good step for the property sector.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The industry asked for a sunset clause under clause 99A so that a sponsor transferring property into a REIT would not be taxed on gains from years of holding it; the interviewee said this tax toll discourages formalisation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said abolishing the sponsor transfer tax, with a sunset clause and no withholding tax on entry into a REIT, would have let REITs grow much faster.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: More than 25 REIT projects are under development, some privately held, and about five of them are listed on the stock exchange, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: During the 2026 US-Iran war and related geopolitical tension, the Pakistan equity market fell close to 10%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: During the 2026 US-Iran tension, REITs fell by less than half the market's drop, and the strongest REITs absorbed the decline with a fall of about 4%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said REITs' resilience in the sell-off shows they can support investors through market volatility and inflation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: Property fractionalisation, splitting a large property into small units, and tokenisation were described as having proof of concept in Pakistan, and the interviewee said REITs and tokenisation can work in synergy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said a REIT management company already has the infrastructure to manage investors, invest in properties and develop them, and splitting these functions would pull firms away from their core skills.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said property valuation is a major problem in every Pakistani city, and that investors will accept valuations only with skepticism until global standards such as those of RICS are adopted.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said Pakistani real estate is so undervalued that it could attract foreign investment once valuation standards and independent risk valuation are put in place through government policy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said rents and market capitalisation rates were rising while low transaction volumes kept prices from following, a mismatch he expects to ease as transactions pick up.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee expected property transaction volumes to pick up from 2026 onward, though not back to the 2021-2022 levels.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: Higher transaction volumes were expected to bring price discovery, transparency, liquidity and new investors, and to damp speculative trading in property.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: Listed REIT units trade on the stock exchange like shares, so investors can buy and sell property exposure through a brokerage account.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said a REIT lets a retail investor own a share of large property for an amount about the cost of a dinner, making property ownership an option for ordinary people.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said REITs let investors diversify across locations and property types, instead of owning a single shop, office or home.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said a hotel REIT lets retail investors become part-owners of hotels, since only a handful of people in Pakistan own hotels outright.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said REIT portfolios are heavily concentrated in residential property and should expand into other categories such as hotels, which his firm said it is pursuing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said the FY27 budget granted many IT-related tax exemptions, which would support data-centre real estate.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said institutional investment is increasingly flowing into data centres, because Pakistan pays for imported streaming and banking data services that could be hosted locally and later exported.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: REITs in Pakistan are overseen by the SECP, which requires semi-annual and annual reports to investors and requires a REIT fund manager to manage the whole fund.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said REITs are a superior model to conventional property because SECP oversight leaves little room for investors' money to disappear, unlike conventional property where loopholes exist.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee advised investors to choose rental REITs as the safer model and developmental or hybrid REITs for growth, and to diversify across them to hedge economic, political and inflation shocks.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)

fact_text: The interviewee said REITs formalise and corporatise a conventional real-estate industry that otherwise operates informally.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan Real Estate After Budget FY27 | REITs, Property Taxes &  Opportunities | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-28)
